about: a blocking HTTP call inside an async function

answer.title: Blocking requests.get inside an async function
answer.description: requests.get blocks the event loop for the whole HTTP round trip, so every other request handled by this worker waits up to 5 seconds while one profile loads.
answer.suggestion: Use an async client: async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=5) as client: response = await client.get(url).

about: a model loaded inside a request handler

answer.title: Embedding model loaded on every request
answer.description: Each call to /embed reads the model weights from disk and initializes them before encoding, so the load cost is paid once per request instead of once per process, and concurrent requests each hold their own copy in memory.
answer.suggestion: Load it once at module level or in the app lifespan: MODEL = SentenceTransformer("all-MiniLM-L6-v2"), then return MODEL.encode(texts).tolist().
